<w:p w14:paraId="4FCEB86D" w14:textId="0E973EE3" w:rsidR="00367525" w:rsidRDefault="0013531D" w:rsidP="00A87366"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="NormalWeb"/><w:spacing w:before="240" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0"/><w:jc w:val="both"/><w:rPr><w:i/><w:iCs/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidRPr="0013531D"><w:rPr><w:i/><w:iCs/></w:rPr><w:t>Business Sustainability is one of the major challenges faced by grilled chicken culinary MSMEs in Bekasi Regency amid increasingly intense business competition. The use of Digital Marketing and the strengthening of Entrepreneurial Orientation have become relevant strategies to support Business Sustainability, although their implementation among MSME actors has not been fully optimized. This study aims to analyze the influence of Digital Marketing and Entrepreneurial Orientation on Business Sustainability in grilled chicken culinary MSMEs in Bekasi Regency. The research used a quantitative approach with a survey method involving 100 respondents selected through purposive sampling techniques. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using multiple linear regression analysis with the assistance of SPSS version 25 software. The results showed that Digital Marketing and Entrepreneurial Orientation had a positive and significant effect on Business Sustainability, both partially and simultaneously. These findings indicate that the ability of business actors to utilize digital media, build interactions with customers, and possess innovative, proactive, and opportunity-oriented attitudes plays an important role in increasing competitiveness and maintaining Business Sustainability.
